label: Los Angeles (city)

county_election_office.name: Los Angeles County Registrar-Recorder/County Clerk (LAVote.gov), 12400 Imperial Hwy, Norwalk

zip_caveats: The USPS puts 'Los Angeles, CA' on mail for many places that are not in the City of Los Angeles, and those voters do NOT get the Mayor, City Attorney, Council or city measures (TE, LA, PL, EE, PRK, PRT, FD). Watch these: 90035 and 90036 straddle the city line with Beverly Hills and unincorporated areas; 90046 and 90069 are split between LA (Hollywood Hills) and West Hollywood; 90048 is split between LA (Fairfax, Beverly Grove) and West Hollywood; 90034 and 90066 (Mar Vista, Palms) border Culver City; 90045 (Westchester) is city but 90293 (Playa del Rey) and 90094 (Playa Vista) mix city and county pockets; 90008, 90043, 90047, 90056, 90059 and 90062 include unincorporated View Park, Windsor Hills, Ladera Heights, Athens and Florence-Graham; 90210 is mostly Beverly Hills but includes a sliver of LA; 90265 (Malibu) and 90402 (Santa Monica) are other cities; 90291 (Venice) is city but 90292 (Marina del Rey) is mostly county. Boyle Heights (90033, 90023) is city; East LA (90022) is unincorporated county. Downtown and the Arts District (90012, 90013, 90014, 90015, 90017, 90021) are all city. Charter Amendment SC is decided by LAUSD voters, which includes some non-city voters and excludes a few city voters. The only reliable check is the address lookup at lavote.gov/isb.
